entries.zh: 仁义钱：出于仁义、不计息赊借给人的钱款；义贷。
entries.en: money lent on trust out of righteousness — an interest-free loan given as a favour
entries.notes: L 栏「fiar assos endimen.」残损难通（含 [疑]），释义依 H「仁义钱」与 M 音写定。

entries.zh: 代认：替他人出面承认（债务）；代为认账作保。
entries.en: to acknowledge a debt in another's stead; to answer for another by acknowledging it
entries.notes: M 栏「tāy xin」重出两遍，疑原稿重复书写；L 栏有 [疑]。

entries.zh: 担认：承担、担保认账；代人担负债务责任。
entries.en: to take on and acknowledge a debt; to bear surety and answer for it
entries.notes: L 栏同前条作「fiar assos.」且有 [疑]，义取 H「担认」之承担义。

entries.zh: 当人不当物：以人作保、不以物作抵押而放贷。
entries.en: to lend on the man's credit, not on the pledge — trusting the person rather than the collateral

entries.zh: 图智不图力：倚仗智谋而不倚仗气力。
entries.en: to rely on prudence rather than on force

entries.zh: 赊难讨：赊账放出容易，债款难以收回。
entries.en: to give credit easily but collect with difficulty

entries.zh: 保领：作保承领，担保并负责领受（钱物）。
entries.en: to give surety and undertake the charge; to stand bail and take responsibility
guarantor, surety (one who stands for another)
entries.notes: L 栏「fiador. de esso.」有 [残] 与 [疑]，M「gue」读家字亦存疑，然 H「保家」正为闽南语保证人之称。

entries.zh: 管领：掌管、经管（财物事务）并负其责。
entries.en: to manage and have in charge; to administer goods or affairs with responsibility
entries.notes: M 栏末「haour」无对应汉字（有 [疑]），L「fiador」与 H「管领」义有出入，取经管负责一义。

entries.zh: 领认人：出面认领、承担债务的人。
entries.en: the person who comes forward to acknowledge and take on a debt; one who accepts liability
entries.notes: M 栏末音「iòg」无对应字，疑为「约」之残。

entries.zh: 认钱人：承认这笔钱（债）的人；认账者。
entries.en: the one who acknowledges the money, i.e. the debt; a surety who owns the sum
entries.notes: M 栏末音「iòg」无对应字，与前条同例。

entries.zh: 粉：米粉、粉条；带肉块的粉食。
entries.en: rice noodles, vermicelli; noodles served with meat
entries.notes: M 栏「hùn by … de carne」混入西语并有 [疑:carne/carno]，知为带肉之粉食。

entries.zh: 粉汤：米粉汤，以汤煮粉条。
entries.en: rice-noodle soup; noodles served in broth

entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:賁/卖] 未定，M 首音「līen」与「面」不合；L「de harina」与「面」相合，故取麦面义。
M 栏后段「umenbo loa pulos」残损不可解，「huá」亦与「线」音不合；释义依 H「面线」。

entries.zh: 海粉：形似粉条的海味干货（旧说为海兔之卵，作羹汤用）。
entries.en: "sea noodles": a dried marine product resembling vermicelli (sea-hare spawn, used in soups)
entries.notes: 「海粉」为海味干货专名，L 逐字译作 fideos del mar，物类仍属考订。

entries.zh: 操节：操守节概，尤指妇人对丈夫的贞节；守寡守节。
entries.en: chastity and constancy — a woman's fidelity to her husband; faithful widowhood
entries.notes: L 栏缩写丛杂（viuded./cumplix.）且有 [疑]，语义取 H「操节」守节之义。
